Restaurant Food Cost Control Kit
Galaxy Forge Implementation Kit v1.0 (September 2026)

FILES
- restaurant_food_cost_control_guide.pdf : main implementation guide
- restaurant_food_cost_control_workbook.xlsx : Excel workbook (5 sheets)
- restaurant_food_cost_weekly_review_agenda.docx : editable template
- restaurant_food_cost_recipe_cost_card.docx : editable template
- restaurant_food_cost_waste_log_sheet.docx : editable template

HOW TO USE: start with Quick Start (section 2 of the guide), then work the 14-day plan in section 9.
SUPPORT: email support for file/usage questions within 7 days of purchase.
